Amanda (product): Quick sync — we need to lock GA criteria for Predict v2 (adaptive routing + cache profiles). Deadline EOD Thu. Key domains: SLA windows, degradation/fallback policy, billing/pricing tiers, docs/runbook, oncall routing. Who's in?

Josh (eng): I'll own SLA perf numbers. Proposal: 99.9% p95 latency < 300ms for non-streaming predict, 99.95% for hosted premium. fallback to smaller model within 100ms decision. Thoughts?

Li (sre): p95 300ms is tight for some tail models. Can we split by model-class? e.g., base vs large — SLOs per route. Also need circuit-breaker + backpressure: 429 for queue depth > 500ms. I'll write config.

Paul (infra): Autoscale policy and burst pool required. Recommend reserve 30% burst capacity for first 90 days. Also need oncall playbook for region-failover.

Maria (docs): Will draft GA docs and runbook templates. Need sample incidents and recovery steps. Can you list exact SLO numbers & failure modes by tomorrow.

Sara (support): Oncall coverage ok assuming docs + PagerDuty runbook. Need escalation matrix and templated customer comms for SLA incidents.

Nate (fin): Pricing: propose three tiers: dev (best-effort), standard (SLO-backed), premium (SLA credit + priority). Need projected unit costs to set commit numbers. Also clarify burst billing — do we bill overage or throttle?

Josh (eng): burst: technical plan is burst pool with enforced quotas; billing backstop: charge overage at 1.5x standard rate OR auto-throttle after soft cap. Product decides.

Amanda (product): My take: prefer auto-throttle + clear customer-facing docs that soft cap exists; credits only for sustained SLA violation. Action owners: Josh=SLA definitions, Li=ops guards + 429 rules, Paul=autoscale + burst config, Maria=docs, Sara=oncall playbooks, Nate=pricing tiers. Can everyone ack by EOD Wed?

Li (sre): ack. I'll drop a sample 429 rule in #eng-sre.

Paul (infra): ack, will run capacity sim and post numbers.

Maria (docs): ack, will fork Predict repo and start draft.

Sara (support): ack. I'll prep templates.

Nate (fin): ack, want a meeting Thurs to finalize pricing.
